name: GitLab
description: GitLab.com's built-in MCP endpoint: the agent can read issues, merge requests and pipelines and act on them with your GitLab permissions. Self-managed instances use their own address.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (gitlab.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
